transport.framing: One request per line, terminated by LF; server returns one response line per request.
notes: This is a custom TCP text protocol, not HTTP or actual REST.
Except POST/auth, every request must include /auth/{password}.
Payloads containing objects are compact JSON with no literal line breaks.

endpoints.purpose: Checks the password only; does not create a session.
Registers a vehicle as currently parked.

payload.plate: string for CAR/MOTORCYCLE; null or empty for BICYCLE

endpoints.purpose: Finds the active vehicle and calculates its current fee. Read-only: does not collect payment, remove the vehicle, or add revenue.

payload.plate: same plate stored for vehicle; null or empty for BICYCLE

endpoints.purpose: Recalculates the fee on the server, records payment, and removes the active vehicle atomically. Call only after payment is confirmed; do not send a client-calculated amount.

endpoints.purpose: Returns total recorded payment revenue for the selected period, using Vietnam time.

business_rules.plate: CAR and MOTORCYCLE require a non-empty plate; BICYCLE must not have a plate.
business_rules.duplicate_ticket: An already-active ticket cannot be parked again.
business_rules.authentication: Password is checked independently on every request; no session is created.

status_codes.200: Query succeeded; JSON contains result data.
status_codes.400: Malformed request or JSON, invalid vehicle type/period, or unknown operation.
status_codes.404: Vehicle not found or ticket/plate/type does not match.
